definition: The agent tool layer, sandbox, or harness caused the failed operation.
decision_test: Apply first: the agent's tool layer, sandbox, or harness refused, interrupted, or lost the operation, including a command rejected by policy, a sandbox that blocks the GPU driver, or a lost exec cell.

definition: A host-platform fault caused the failed operation.
decision_test: Apply second: a host-platform fault remains after every change the agent could make to its environment selection, command, script, or code, including a read-only shared cache, missing system tool, or driver failure outside the sandbox.

definition: The supplied reference at a removed or defective point caused the failed operation.
decision_test: Apply third: the failed call runs or reads the supplied reference itself at a removed or defective point, and the failure persists in any obtainable environment, including reading a masked file, the reference evaluator failing at its masked line, or an inherited reference defect.

definition: The agent's environment selection, command, script, or code caused the failed operation.
decision_test: Otherwise: the unchanged reference runs once the agent corrects its own environment selection, command, script, or code. This includes code written to replace a C5 masked file and stack choices even when the condition masks setup files.
